note: Anthropic reports that about 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalised a proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in 30 hours during prerelease testing, against 11 days for its earlier effort. This formalises an existing proof and is not a new proof; the page was amended on 11 November to clarify what the model was given.
title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
